pages.title: Block of Spacetime Alloy
pages.text: Nine spacetime alloy ingots pressed into one block. The alloy bends spacetime around itself slightly, so the block's edges never look quite square. It is cold and surprisingly light for its size. Light glancing off it arrives a hair late.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Storing the alloy as a block was the obvious step, but the block bent the space around it more noticeably than the ingots did. I keep it away from clocks.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Alloy Ingot.
